source: Project Operating System Phase 2 - Migration Engine
description: Required gates for approving future migrations.

items.description: Current and migrated behavior must remain equivalent for the asset scope.
Required pre and post tests must pass or be explicitly waived by governance.
Schema, contract, dependency and relationship validations must pass.
SEO metadata, canonical behavior, indexability and URL stability must be preserved.
Runtime files and production JavaScript must remain unchanged unless explicitly in scope.
Rollback files, verification steps and rollback report location must be known.
A human approval must confirm that the migration may proceed.

approvalDecision.approveWhen: All required gates pass and manual approval is recorded.
approvalDecision.rejectWhen: Any required gate fails, evidence is missing or scope is unclear.
approvalDecision.reopenWhen: A failed gate receives new evidence and scope remains unchanged.

notes: Approval gates are protocol requirements for future migrations and do not run checks automatically.
